description: The pie chart presents the distribution of data sources/categories used in the referenced paper, shown as a single pie divided into five slices. The slices are labeled with percentages and counts: “TriviaQA” is a large red slice at about 46% (1829) and is visually emphasized by being exploded/offset from the pie; an unlabeled purple slice at about 25% (997) appears at the top; “HalluEval” is a green slice at about 18% (721); “Chinese Domain” is a yellow slice at about 6% (231) and is also slightly exploded/offset; and “HalluQA” is a light blue slice at about 5% (185). Percentage-and-count labels are placed adjacent to the slices, and there is no separate legend visible; the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment (TriviaQA) through smaller segments around the circle.
